label: SYNTHETIC RAW RESPONSES IN PROVIDER FORMAT - NOT A LIVE CAPTURE
why: The build environment that wrote these files could not reach www.ebi.ac.uk or eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov (egress proxy refused CONNECT, HTTP 403, 2026-10-03). The bodies were written by hand in the documented Europe PMC REST (resultType=core) and NCBI E-utilities (esearch/esummary, retmode=json) response shapes so the real connector code parses them. They are test inputs, not literature: every identifier is synthetic (PMIDs 99000001-99000004, DOI prefix 10.5555 is the Crossref test prefix) and every title starts with [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE].
replaceWith: node scripts/research-run-literature-live-proof.mjs on a host with network access writes real recorded bodies and a manifest of the same shape under artifacts/research-run-literature-live-proof/raw/.
